title: Collaborative large language models (LLMs) are all you need for screening in systematic reviews

live_model.evidence: "Three commercial LLMs (GPT-4 Turbo [4T]...) were used utilizing the versions released in May 2024"; "GPT-4T exhibited a mean precision of 99.74...and a mean recall of 95.5%".

prompt.note: Zero-shot chain-of-thought PICOS screening prompt (task, inclusion criteria, output format, title+abstract), used identically for the independent-LLM and collaborative setups.

claim.location: Results ("Independent individual LLMs without conflict resolution"); Table 2, across five systematic reviews

data.source: code and fully annotated gold-standard datasets released at https://github.com/Mihir3009/SR_LLMs

notes: 11,300 title/abstract pairs across five systematic-review datasets (PARP toxicity, mHCC, mCRPC, mHSPC, RCC); precision for exclusion was even higher (99.74%). The paper also reports collaborative (multi-LLM) setups, but the single-model GPT-4T numbers above are directly attributable to the tracked snapshot.
